says: A report or an opinion is never stored as a fact.
A precaution grants nothing and destroys nothing.
A grant, or anything destructive, needs a fact or you.
Deny beats hold, hold beats allow, and no rule means deny.
The order in which rules were written never changes the result, and a new rule never overrides a deny or a hold that already applies.
A rule is enforced by the engine, outside the computer, and each decision is recorded with the version of the rule.
A proposal changes nothing until you accept it.
Every action Silo can take is filed as granting, destructive or protective.
Allow, hold and deny act on one request that is still waiting, so they exist only in the synchronous case.
